description: Find active coupon codes and deals, by store name and/or keyword. Use for questions like "is there a discount code for Nike?" Returns code, title, end date, store and a tracked link.

countries.description: ISO country codes to limit offers to, e.g. ["US"] or ["GB","IE"]

endingWithinDays.description: Only offers that end within N days

query.description: Keyword in the offer, e.g. "free shipping", "20%"

name: search_coupons
title: Search coupons
